strongest_objection: The of-sentence promises every item four parts, the conversion, its carrier, the shape of the rate, and the place where the same conversion is called fraud, and six of eighteen items deliver three: Unrefusable glance, Furniture's ear, Familiarity as vetting, Witnessed save, Practice given to the trusted, and Standing left at the border name no fraud site, and two of those (the planted ear, the staged save) have the most instructive fraud forms on the whole map, so the omission costs distinctions rather than words. Where the rate-and-fraud clause is present in Scar tariff it contradicts the item's own first exemplar: soldiers are salaried, so 'compensated sacrifice converts at almost nothing' would strip the veteran of the authority the item opens with; and as written that clause is identical to Injury as license's refusal on compensation, so the two items collapse until Scar is repaired to mean a loss priced before it was taken rather than an account closed after. Everything else I tried to break held: the bearer/registry distinction survives a boundary case (reflected glory), the loop and the incompatibility are real relations a sequence cannot show, and the closing rule survives the self-financed candidate only because that exemplar is wrong, not because the rule is.

items.item: Unrefusable glance: beauty converts into audience through attention the audience does not choose to pay, as the pretty busker draws the crowd the better player did not, and nobody has to decide anything for the conversion to run; the rate is highest at first sight and falls with exposure, and the same beauty converts into credit at a discount, because attention that was not chosen is not read as anyone's judgment.
items.why: The type promises a fraud site and the item names none; beauty's fraud form is instructive because it is the only one on the map that counterfeits the carrier itself rather than the entry.
items.repair: Unrefusable glance: beauty converts into audience through attention the audience does not choose to pay, as the pretty busker draws the crowd the better player did not, and nobody has to decide anything for the conversion to run; the rate is highest at first sight and falls with exposure, and the same beauty converts into credit at a discount, because attention that was not chosen is not read as anyone's judgment, and the fraud is the retouched face, the filter, and the catfish, which collect the glance for a face that is not in the room.

items.item: Furniture's ear: access converts into information in proportion to how little standing the person present has, as valets, drivers, interpreters, and the junior aide hear what the visiting minister is performed for; high standing buys the stage and low standing buys the wings, and the conversion is refused to whoever the room notices, so the rate falls the moment one is promoted.
items.why: The strangest mechanism on the map and it stops before its fraud form, which is the borrowed low place: the conversion runs on purpose whenever someone takes the wings without holding the standing that pays for them. Note also that the product, information, is a bearer balance rather than conferred standing, which is exactly why the item belongs at the no-writer end of the axis and should not be domesticated into an access item.
items.repair: Furniture's ear: access converts into information in proportion to how little standing the person present has, as valets, drivers, interpreters, and the junior aide hear what the visiting minister is performed for; high standing buys the stage and low standing buys the wings, and the conversion is refused to whoever the room notices, so the rate falls the moment one is promoted, and the fraud is the borrowed low place, the owner who poses as the new hire and the reporter in the waiter's coat, who take the wings without holding the standing that pays for them.

items.item: Familiarity as vetting: fame converts into credit because a recognized name is processed as a prior acquaintance, as the actor is trusted with a policy and the television doctor with a supplement; generous in every domain the audience does not itself practice, and refused inside the guild, whose members meet the same name as a stranger's, so the rate is set by the audience's ignorance rather than by the fame.
items.why: Names the refusal (the guild) but no fraud; affinity fraud is this conversion run deliberately, and it is the case that shows the rate is set by the audience's ignorance rather than by the fame.
items.repair: Familiarity as vetting: fame converts into credit because a recognized name is processed as a prior acquaintance, as the actor is trusted with a policy and the television doctor with a supplement; generous in every domain the audience does not itself practice, and refused inside the guild, whose members meet the same name as a stranger's, so the rate is set by the audience's ignorance rather than by the fame, and the affinity swindler is the fraud, who spends a year becoming a familiar face in the congregation so that recognition will be processed as vetting when the money is asked for.

items.item: Witnessed save: competence converts into deference through a moment with stakes that others saw, as the night nurse who caught the tenfold dose is deferred to by physicians for years afterward; a credential claims the same competence without the witness and converts at a fraction, so the rate is set by the stakes and the audience present, not by the skill, and the competent who were never in the room hold an unconverted balance.
items.why: The credential-at-a-fraction clause is a discount, not a fraud; the fraud form is the staged save, which is real in exactly the trades the register names and shows what the mechanism actually pays for, namely stakes plus a witness, not skill.
items.repair: Witnessed save: competence converts into deference through a moment with stakes that others saw, as the night nurse who caught the tenfold dose is deferred to by physicians for years afterward; a credential claims the same competence without the witness and converts at a fraction, so the rate is set by the stakes and the audience present, not by the skill, and the competent who were never in the room hold an unconverted balance, and the staged save is the fraud, the nurse who induces the crisis she then catches and the engineer who plants the failure he then fixes, which borrows the witness by supplying the stakes.

items.item: Scar tariff: sacrifice converts into authority in proportion to what cannot be recovered, as the veteran, the striker who lost the house, and the founder who ate the lean years are heard before the unscarred; compensated sacrifice converts at almost nothing, since a paid martyr is an employee, and stolen valor is the fraud of claiming the authority without having paid the tariff.
items.why: The rate clause contradicts the item's own first exemplar: soldiers are salaried, so 'compensated sacrifice converts at almost nothing' would strip the veteran of authority. The mechanism survives only if compensation means the loss itself was priced and accepted for the price, which also separates this item from Injury as license, whose refusal is a closed account after the fact rather than a price agreed before.
items.repair: Scar tariff: sacrifice converts into authority in proportion to what cannot be recovered, as the veteran, the striker who lost the house, and the founder who ate the lean years are heard before the unscarred; sacrifice priced and accepted for the price converts at almost nothing, since a paid martyr is an employee, though a wage for the labor leaves the tariff on the loss untouched, which is why the salaried soldier keeps his authority and the mercenary does not, and stolen valor is the fraud of claiming the authority without having paid the tariff.

items.item: Practice given to the trusted: standing converts back into competence, the reverse of the witnessed save, because whoever is already deferred to is handed the hard cases and becomes what he was presumed, as the resident the chief likes is given the interesting surgeries; the rate is generous and the product is indistinguishable afterward from competence that earned its own presumption, which is the discount nobody can collect.
items.why: No fraud site, but here the absence is the discovery rather than an omission: the counterfeit product and the genuine one are the same hands. The item should say so, since as written a reader takes the missing clause for a gap rather than the point.
items.repair: Practice given to the trusted: standing converts back into competence, the reverse of the witnessed save, because whoever is already deferred to is handed the hard cases and becomes what he was presumed, as the resident the chief likes is given the interesting surgeries; the rate is generous and the product is indistinguishable afterward from competence that earned its own presumption, which is the discount nobody can collect, and it is the one conversion with no fraud form, since the favorite's hands and the earned hands are the same hands, so the patron who presents his allocation as a verdict cannot be caught by any later test of the product.

items.item: Standing left at the border: conferred standing is a balance in the conferrers' ledger and not in the holder, so it does not travel with the body, as the Damascus surgeon who drives a taxi in Berlin is exactly as skilled and has lost all deference; the conversion fails by venue rather than by rate, and the local registry prices re-entry as if from zero, because it never wrote the entry it is being asked to honor.
items.why: Two gaps. First, the only case given is a credentialed one, which makes the item read as the failure clause of Notarized standing; the uncredentialed case (fame or deference with no paper at all) is what shows the border is broader than the credential and fires where notarization was never in play. Second, no fraud site; the fraud at a border runs on the registry's side, the refusal that is really a tariff, and that is a stranger and more usable observation than anything the holder could counterfeit.
items.repair: Standing left at the border: conferred standing is a balance in the conferrers' ledger and not in the holder, so it does not travel with the body, as the Damascus surgeon who drives a taxi in Berlin is exactly as skilled and has lost all deference, and the Lagos chef whose fame had no paper at all loses it just as completely; the conversion fails by venue rather than by rate, the local registry prices re-entry as if from zero, because it never wrote the entry it is being asked to honor, and the fraud here runs on the registry's side, the guild that calls a foreign entry unverifiable when it is merely unwelcome, so that a closed shop is presented as a standard.

items.item: Evidence that spending erases: conferred standing is valuable as evidence of someone else's judgment, so buying it destroys what was bought, as the purchased title, the self-financed candidate, and the bought followers each announce that no one else would have conferred them; the one-way rule of the map, that whatever standing functions as another party's verdict cannot be converted into by money, only by a verdict-giver who is not the holder and gains nothing from him.
items.why: The self-financed candidate is a mis-exemplar: his money buys the campaign and the voters still write the entry, so what he forfeits is only the donors' verdict, and a candidate who wins holds conferred standing bought in part with his own money. The mechanism is right; that case does not show it. Replaced with a case where the fee was the whole jury.
items.repair: Evidence that spending erases: conferred standing is valuable as evidence of someone else's judgment, so buying it destroys what was bought, as the purchased title, the bought followers, and the award whose entry fee was the whole jury each announce that no one else would have conferred them; the one-way rule of the map, that whatever standing functions as another party's verdict cannot be converted into by money, only by a verdict-giver who is not the holder and gains nothing from him.

neighbor_test.left: Scar tariff: sacrifice converts into authority in proportion to what cannot be recovered, as the veteran, the striker who lost the house, and the founder who ate the lean years are heard before the unscarred; compensated sacrifice converts at almost nothing, since a paid martyr is an employee, and stolen valor is the fraud of claiming the authority without having paid the tariff.
neighbor_test.right: Injury as license: grievance converts into standing through the injured party's right to speak first and to be answered, as the bereaved mother addresses the legislature and the wronged employee is given the floor; refused once compensation is accepted, because the payment closes the account, and refused again when the injury was manufactured or bought, while whether it may be inherited past living memory is contested and this map leaves it so.
neighbor_test.separating_case: As written they collapse on the refusal clause: both convert a loss into being heard, both are refused on compensation, and both name a counterfeit loss as the fraud. They separate once compensation is read differently in each. The veteran who draws a disability pension is still heard first on the war, because the wage and the pension price his labor and his upkeep, not the leg; the wrongfully fired employee who signs the settlement loses the floor the day the account closes. Scar's refusal turns on whether the loss was priced and accepted before it was taken (the mercenary), Injury's on whether the account was closed after (the settlement), and the authority runs toward a cause while the license runs against a wrongdoer. The separation requires the Scar tariff repair above; without it the two items share an operator.

boundary_case: Reflected glory is the tempting nonmember: the entourage, the courtier, the man photographed beside the star. It has a rate (falls with distance and with the number of people in the picture) and a fraud (name-dropping, the faked selfie), so it presents as a member. It is out because the form of standing does not change, only the holder: prestige becomes prestige. The map's own ruling on the inherited name covers it, and the test clarifies the type, since Introducer's tab also moves standing between holders but changes its form (the introducer's credit becomes the introduced's access), so a change of holder is permitted and a change of form is required.

seriation.note: The axis has real endpoints and they are the same word for opposite reasons: Unrefusable glance needs no writer because its product is bearer-form and there is no entry, Evidence that spending erases needs no writer from the holder's side because the holder cannot be the writer. That is the actual shape of the walk, a crossing from bearer to registry, and the hinge pair Gift that keeps no hand followed by Cashing out earns its place by showing the round trip leaks in both currencies, which nothing in the pile shows. Notarized standing followed by Standing left at the border teaches that the credential is the device built for the failure the next item names. The one arguable position is Immunity by entanglement, which accrues without anyone deciding, like the glance, and only sits in the registry-that-waits band because the institution's dependence is treated as the writer; the author's band absorbs it but a reader could reasonably put it near the front.

edges.why: The label puts the fork at compensation and asserts that the memoir refunds the tariff; the wounded veteran's memoir is far more often the display of the scar than its sale, and displaying it adds to the stock. The fork is real but sits at whether a price is attached to the loss itself, which is also where the repaired Scar tariff puts its refusal; as written the label is speculation promoted to a rule and would contradict the repaired item.
edges.repair_label: If the sacrifice is cashed at a price the loss itself carries, as the settlement or the sponsored account that sells the wound rather than shows it, the tariff is re-read as a fee and the authority drains at the rate the money arrives; but the memoir that displays the scar without pricing it converts the other way and adds to the stock, so the fork sits not at compensation as such but at whether a price is attached to the loss, and the veteran holds both authority and salary only so long as the salary is for something other than the wound.

edges.why: 'The same clock that admits the incomer's children expires the carpenter's credit' conflates two registries, the parish and the trade, so the antecedent as stated does not produce the consequent. The passage the form_inference claims is real once each registry is charged on its own clock: a registry that credits presence in years debits absence in the same unit, and nothing but years moves the hand.
edges.repair_label: If a registry denominates admission in years served, then its only debit is also years: absence is charged on the clock that credited presence, so the parish that admits the incomer's children after a generation strikes the emigrant after one, and the trade that made the journeyman a master by years subtracts the carpenter's six years out; neither a sum nor a document moves the hand, and the conversions are one-way because the clock does not run backward.

edges.why: The best edge on the map: a genuine incompatibility whose antecedent can fail (the aide who saves quietly, off the record, keeps the ear), and nothing in a sequence shows it.
A real loop with a named entry problem; the antecedent fails under rotation or lottery allocation, which is the operator's lever.

modality_problems: Scar tariff states 'compensated sacrifice converts at almost nothing' as a rule while naming the salaried veteran as its first exemplar; the rule is false as stated and true only for a loss priced and accepted in advance.

The Scar tariff to Cashing out label asserts that the veteran's memoir refunds the tariff and that he is 're-read as having been paid all along'; this is speculation presented as a rule, and the commoner case runs the other way, the memoir being the scar's display rather than its sale.

Evidence that spending erases uses the self-financed candidate as a case of erased standing, but his purchase buys the campaign and the voters still write the entry; only the donors' verdict is forfeited, so the example overstates the mechanism it illustrates.

The Time as the only tender to Staleness discount label says the same clock admits the incomer's children and expires the carpenter's credit, conflating the parish registry with the trade registry; the claim holds per registry, not across them.

Time as the only tender's 'no sum buys a second year inside the same year' survives the donor made trustee within a year only by reclassifying every fast admission as a purchase under Evidence that spending erases; the item should say that the reclassification is what defends the rule, otherwise the rule is circular.
duplication: none as a whole. Introducer's tab is adjacent to exchange-ontologies' Vouching and says what it adds (the converter pays). Witnessed save is adjacent in spirit to witness-architectures, but that list types the instruments that let a fact leave a trace, not conversions of standing. Immunity by entanglement is not a ghost-leverage, since the dependence is live rather than obsolete.
best_unresolved_seed: Marriage as registrar. The conversion every novel runs, the mill-owner's money into the baronet's name and the beauty into the house, is absent, and it is the one case that tests the closing rule, because the writer of the new entry (the receiving family) gains from the holder and writes the entry anyway. Either the family name is a registry that launders a purchase into a conferral by Time as the only tender, so that the purchase clause is dropped from the grandchildren's entry, or the one-way rule has an exception wherever the verdict-giver is bound for life to the verdict. The author's own held seed, fear laundered into honor across a generation, is the same question with threat in place of money. A probe: take three marriages into standing and find at which generation the purchase stops being mentioned in the receiving registry, and whether a divorce reopens it.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted after repairing eight items (six that omitted the fraud site the type promises, one whose compensation clause contradicted its own salaried veteran, one mis-exemplar) and two edge labels, with Scar tariff and Injury as license separating only after the repair.
